certifiedResults.title: Iowa official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County presidential totals are parsed from the Iowa Secretary of State 2024 General Election canvass summary PDF, using the President and Vice President county Total rows and reconciling them to the statewide Total row.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Iowa Secretary of State canvass summary identifies the 2024 General Election held November 5, 2024 and a canvass date of December 2, 2024. Local copy was collected from the Iowa state board meeting attachment because the SOS CDN blocks command-line downloads.

wardDetail.title: Iowa precinct or reporting-unit detail
wardDetail.detail: The loaded statewide canvass source is county-level for this pipeline. Review drilldowns need an official precinct or reporting-unit source before they can be enabled.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: State canvass summary was checked during Iowa official-source promotion.

turnout.title: Iowa turnout denominator
turnout.detail: The canvass summary includes contest vote totals, undervotes, and overvotes, but no registered-voter denominator. Turnout should stay disabled until an official registration or turnout source is mapped.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Official canvass summary lacks registered-voter denominator fields.
